# CALCULA VALOR DE MERCADO DEL ACTIVO DE LOS HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES CON BANCOS
# Las rutas SAS a archivos .sas7bdat de ratios externos se reemplazan por rutas relativas al workspace (M-001)
ratio_inv_hc_c = pd.read_sas(Path("insumos") / "ratio_inv_hc_c.sas7bdat", encoding="latin1")

work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #vm_af5_hc_d"))
bd_ctsi_af5_d = pd.read_sql(text("SELECT * FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI"), work_conn)
# el ratio se lee de archivo externo (no versionado en la BD): el cruce se hace en pandas y se sube el resultado
cruce_vm_d = bd_ctsi_af5_d.merge(
    ratio_inv_hc_c.rename(columns={"RATIO": "RATIO_"}),
    on=["AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_ENTRADA", "C_CUENTA", "C_SCN"],
    how="inner",
)
cruce_vm_d["DATO_CALC"] = cruce_vm_d["DATO"] * cruce_vm_d["RATIO_"] - cruce_vm_d["DATO"]
vm_af5_hc_d = (
    cruce_vm_d.assign(MONEDA="P", FUENTE="VM", PROC="0300")
    .groupby(["AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_CUENTA", "C_ENTRADA", "C_SCN", "N_SCN", "FUENTE", "PROC"], as_index=False)["DATO_CALC"]
    .sum()
    .rename(columns={"DATO_CALC": "DATO"})
)
vm_af5_hc_d.to_sql("#vm_af5_hc_d", work_conn, if_exists="replace", index=False)
_log("vm_af5_hc_d", vm_af5_hc_d)
# REC PRECIO POR AJUSTAR A MERCADO
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #rp_af5_hc_d"))
work_conn.execute(text("""
SELECT MONEDA, [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, 'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN, FUENTE, '0303' AS PROC,
       SUM(CASE WHEN C_CUENTA = 'Bce Inicio' THEN DATO*-1 ELSE DATO END) AS DATO
INTO #rp_af5_hc_d
FROM #vm_af5_hc_d
GROUP BY MONEDA, [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN, FUENTE
"""))

cols_vm_rp_d = "MONEDA, [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN, FUENTE, PROC, DATO"
for tmp in ["#vm_af5_hc_d", "#rp_af5_hc_d"]:
    sql_append = f"INSERT INTO TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI ({cols_vm_rp_d}) SELECT {cols_vm_rp_d} FROM {tmp}"
    res = work_conn.execute(text(sql_append))
    _log(f"APPEND TABLAS.BD_CTSI desde {tmp}", res.rowcount)
for tmp in ["#vm_af5_hc_d", "#rp_af5_hc_d"]:
    work_conn.execute(text(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {tmp}"))
# IMPUTA INVERSIONES EN AF5 DE HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES ENTRE EL SECTOR USANDO INFO DEL PATRIMONIO A VALOR LIBRO. AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN EN CA 2.
# PATRIMONIO VM DE 37 Y 36907 CON CA 37 Y 36907
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #vm_af5_hc_p"))
work_conn.execute(text("""
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA, [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
INTO #vm_af5_hc_p
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI
WHERE C_SCN = 'AF.5' AND SECTOR IN (37, 36907) AND C_CAGENTE IN ('37', '36907') AND C_ENTRADA = 'H'
GROUP BY [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN
"""))

# ratio de patrimonio a valor libro: archivo externo no versionado (ver warnings) -> se procesa en pandas
ratio_pat_hc_c = pd.read_sas(Path("insumos") / "ratio_pat_hc_c.sas7bdat", encoding="latin1")
vm_af5_hc_p = pd.read_sql(text("SELECT * FROM #vm_af5_hc_p"), work_conn)
cruce_vl_p = vm_af5_hc_p.merge(
    ratio_pat_hc_c,
    on=["AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_ENTRADA", "C_CUENTA", "C_SCN"],
    how="inner",
    suffixes=("", "_r"),
)
cruce_vl_p["DATO"] = cruce_vl_p["DATO"] / cruce_vl_p["DATO_r"] - cruce_vl_p["DATO"]
vl_af5_hc_p = cruce_vl_p[["MONEDA", "AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_CUENTA", "C_ENTRADA", "C_SCN", "N_SCN", "DATO"]]

# RESTA EFECTO VALOR LIBRO DE RP
rp_af5_hc_p = (
    vl_af5_hc_p.assign(C_CUENTA_ORIG=vl_af5_hc_p["C_CUENTA"], C_CUENTA="Rec Precio")
)
rp_af5_hc_p["DATO"] = np.where(rp_af5_hc_p["C_CUENTA_ORIG"] == "Bce Inicio", rp_af5_hc_p["DATO"] * -1, rp_af5_hc_p["DATO"])
rp_af5_hc_p = (
    rp_af5_hc_p.groupby(["MONEDA", "AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_ENTRADA", "C_SCN", "N_SCN", "C_CUENTA"], as_index=False)["DATO"]
    .sum()
)

# JUNTA BASES PARA PODER CALCULAR DIFERENCIAL A VALOR LIBRO A IMPUTAR EN ACTIVO DE 37 Y 36907
vm_af5_hc_p_full = pd.concat([vm_af5_hc_p, vl_af5_hc_p, rp_af5_hc_p], ignore_index=True)

# AGRUPA TABLA ANTERIOR CON BALANCES A VALOR LIBRO
vm_af5_hc_p_full["SECTOR_NUEVO"] = pd.to_numeric(vm_af5_hc_p_full["C_CAGENTE"], errors="coerce")
vm_af5_hc_p_full["C_CAGENTE_NUEVO"] = vm_af5_hc_p_full["SECTOR"].astype(str)
ag_af5_hc_p = (
    vm_af5_hc_p_full.assign(SECTOR=vm_af5_hc_p_full["SECTOR_NUEVO"], C_CAGENTE=vm_af5_hc_p_full["C_CAGENTE_NUEVO"], C_ENTRADA="D")
    .groupby(["MONEDA", "AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_CUENTA", "C_ENTRADA", "C_SCN", "N_SCN"], as_index=False)["DATO"]
    .sum()
)

# INV AF5 DE 37 Y 36907 CON CA 37 Y 36907
inv_af5_hc_hc = pd.read_sql(text("""
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA, [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN, SUM(DATO)*-1 AS DATO
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI
WHERE C_SCN = 'AF.5' AND SECTOR IN (37, 36907) AND C_CAGENTE IN ('37', '36907') AND C_ENTRADA = 'D'
GROUP BY [AÑO], TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN, N_SCN
"""), work_conn)

# CALCULA DELTA DE INVERSIONES A IMPUTAR EN 37 Y 36907, RESPECTIVAMENTE
ag_af5_hc_p = pd.concat([ag_af5_hc_p, inv_af5_hc_hc], ignore_index=True)
imp_af5_hc_hc = (
    ag_af5_hc_p.groupby(["MONEDA", "AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_CUENTA", "C_ENTRADA", "C_SCN", "N_SCN"], as_index=False)["DATO"]
    .sum()
)
imp_af5_hc_hc["FUENTE"] = "PS"
imp_af5_hc_hc["PROC"] = "0304"
imp_af5_hc_hc = imp_af5_hc_hc[imp_af5_hc_hc["DATO"] != 0]

# AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN 37 Y 36907 CON CA 2
imp_af5_hc_2 = (
    imp_af5_hc_hc.assign(C_CAGENTE="2")
    .groupby(["MONEDA", "AÑO", "TRIM", "SECTOR", "C_CAGENTE", "C_CUENTA", "C_ENTRADA", "C_SCN", "N_SCN"], as_index=False)["DATO"]
    .sum()
)
imp_af5_hc_2["DATO"] = imp_af5_hc_2["DATO"] * -1
imp_af5_hc_2["FUENTE"] = "PS"
imp_af5_hc_2["PROC"] = "0304b"

imp_af5_hc_hc.to_sql("IMP_AF5_HC_HC", work_conn, if_exists="append", index=False)
imp_af5_hc_2.to_sql("IMP_AF5_HC_2", work_conn, if_exists="append", index=False)
_log("imp_af5_hc_hc", imp_af5_hc_hc)
_log("imp_af5_hc_2", imp_af5_hc_2)
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #vm_af5_hc_p"))
